tei:div.tei:p: (ja)༄༅// kusumālināmakār+yār+thadhar+m+maṇāṃtapis+thāyās+san+deshaḥprash+not+tarabidzahāraṃ//

༄༅// dgos skabs chos kyi dka' gnas kyi dogs pa dris pa'i lan ldon me tog phreng ba zhes bya ba bzhugs so// dge legs mtshan gyi mdangs 'od ring 'phro bas// 'thibs bu'i mun 'phrog 'jam dpal nyin mo'i mgon// dran pas shes bya'i dka' gnas gsal byed pa// 'jig rten mig mtshungs de yis rtag tu skyongs// ring mo'i dus nas blo ster ngag dbang lhas// byin rlabs chos rab 'byed pa'i shes rab rtsal// mtshar sdug rkang rtses bsnun pa'i a sho ka /'dab gsar stong gis dgod bzhin blta ba nas// 'phong skyen grogs su bcol yang dga' byed kyis// yal ga'i ri dwags dgra grogs ma phyed pa// de srid nyag phran btang pa 'gog pa de// dpyod ldan mkhas pa'i blo gros ma yin nam// de'ang 'dir mchid du bgro ba nyid ni/ mkhas btsun bzang po'i yon tan gyis kun nas mdzes shing*/ khyad par gsang chen rgyud kyis bstan bya snying po bde ba chen po 'dzin par byed pa'i dkyil 'khor bye ba'i mnga' bdag tu gyur pa'i mchog gi rdo rje slob dpon chen po zhal dkar 'tsho byed mkhas pa'i rigs kyi skye ba'i sdong bu bzung ba'i bla ma ngag dbang shes rab ces bya ba'i bod phyogs dang ldan pa de nyid nas/ dgos skabs 'ga' zhig nas mkhyen dpyod skyes bu som nyi'i dpyangs thag la 'phyang bar gyur pa'i dri tshig nyung shas phebs par/ rang blor gang shar gyi go tshul dang mthun pa'i zhu lan mdor bsdus 'bul ba la/ dri tshig dang por/ dbang chu mdzes rgyan gyi gtor bsngo dang*/ phyi rol gtor ma'i sgrub pa'i yan lag skabs/ ye shes pa 'byung po nyer bzhi'i rnam par spyan 'dren pa las/ sku gsung thugs kyi gtso bo spyan 'dren tshig zin mi snang la/ gtor chog rnam bshad phrin las rgyas byed las/ de la yang yan lag bzhi ma rdzogs na cho ga ma tshang bar rnal 'byor dbang phyug bzhed cing*/ zhes pas gtso bo rnams la yan lag bzhi ka ma tshang ba'i dogs gnas ji ltar spong zhes phebs par/

lan 'bul ba ni/ spyir 'di la cho ga'i thog mthar gsum du sbyin pa'i gtor ma gsum las/ dang po ni sngon 'gro gtor ma dang*/ bar du sbyin pa ni phyi rol gtor ma ste/ 'di la kha cig dkyil 'khor blta bar mi dbang ba'i 'byung po yin zer ba sogs ni mi 'thad de/ 'byung po nyer bzhi po 'di sngon rdo rje 'chang gis rgyud gsungs pa'i tshe dkyil 'khor du bcug ste/ dbang bskur nas bstan pa bsrung bar khas blangs pa sogs lung rigs kyis bkag zin pa ltar yin la/ 'dir ni dkyil 'khor gyi khang pa'i phyi rol du gtor ma btang bas na phyi rol zhes pa dang*/ phyogs bzhi'i gtor ma'i skabs su spyan drangs pa'i mgron nam/ sngon 'gro gtor ma'i skabs su 'dus pa'i mgron rnams/ dkyil 'khor gyi khang pa'i phyi rol du bar chad bsrung ba'i phyir/ phyi rol du bzhugs nas bar chad bsrung ba'i bya ba la khur che bas/ dkyil 'khor gyi khang pa'i phyi rol du btang ba yin pa sogs ni thugs la mnga' ltar lags shing*/ skabs su babs pa'i don/ rje rdo rje 'chang gis/ mdun bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor dang ma 'brel na/ dbus su dkyil 'khor gsar du bskyed dgos la/ de la yan lag bzhi ma rdzogs na cho ga ma tshang bar rnal 'byor dbang phyug bzhed ces 'byung ba/ da lta'i dbang chu mdzes rgyan gyi mdun bskyed gtor bsngo dang*/ phyi rol gtor ma'i skabs/ ye shes pa 'byung po nyer bzhi'i rnam par spyan 'dren pa tshig gis dngos su bstan pa las/ gtso bo gsum dmigs bsal ma thon yang*/ rdo rje gsum po spyan 'dren dgos par mngon te/ rje rdo rje 'chang gis rnam bshad du/ mgron bskyed pa/ dgug pa/ byin gyis brlab pa/ dbang bskur ba ste bzhi las/ dang po chos 'byung sum brtsegs kyi nang du/ paṃ las pad+ma 'dab brgyad re re'i lte bar/ rnal 'byor dbang phyug gi bzhed pa ltar rdo rje gsum gyi lha rnams rim bzhin bskyed pa'i/

steng mar rdo rje gur las/ nyi zla tshangs pa la sogs dang*// tshangs pa'i ris ni dam pa dang*// zhes sogs kyis bstan pa'i lha chen brgyad dang*/ bar par/ dbang po shar gyi 'dab mar bsam// zhes sogs kyis phyogs skyong brgyad dang*/ 'og mar/ stobs kyi rgyu dang dung skyong dang*// zhes sogs kyis klu chen brgyad bskyed par bstan/ gnyis pa mgron dgug pa ni/ mar me mdzad/ a ba dhū tī pa/ nag po pa/ rje btsun sogs bzhed pa mthun par/ rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer nag po lcags kyu lta bu phyogs bcur spros nas/ des lha chen brgyad la tshangs pa kun 'khor sogs gzugs khams kyi lha rnams dang*/ bde ba can/ ri rab kyi byang shar 'od zer can gyi 'jig rten khams na gnas pa rnams dang*/ nam mkha' mtha' yas sogs gzugs med skye mched mu bzhir gnas pa bcas bsdu ba dang*/ phyogs skyong brgyad la rgyal chen ris bzhi la sogs pa'i 'dod lha ris drug dang*/ mkha' 'gro dang*/ 'byung po dang*/ 'dre dang*/ srin po dang*/ mi la sogs pa'i sa stengs na rgyu ba rnams bsdu ba dang*/ klu chen brgyad la dmyal ba la sogs pa'i ngan 'gro gsum/ lha ma yin/ klu la sogs pa sa 'og na gnas pa rnams bsdu ste/ de rnams dang gnyis su med par bya bar gsungs so// gsum pa byin gyis brlabs pa ni/ rang bzhin gyi gnas na bzhugs pa'i ye shes kyi lha spyan drang ba'i phyir/ rang gi snying ga'i sa bon las sngar bzhin 'od 'phros pas/ phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i rnam par spyan drangs par bsams la/ zhes gsungs pa 'dis shes te/ rdo rje gsum gyi lha'i rnam par spyan drangs pas gtso bo gsum nges par bstan pa'i phyir/ gzhan yang der dkyil 'khor dang ma 'brel ba'i tshe gtor ma btang ba na'ang*/ bdag bskyed bsdus ma bsdus gnyis ka'i skabs nas kyang rdo rje gsum gyi lha 'khor du bcas pa'i mgron bskyed par bshad pa'i rjes thogs su'ang*/

de nas mgron dgug pa/ byin gyis brlabs pa/ dbang bskur ba'i bar 'og nas 'byung ba bzhin byas la/ zhes pa'i skabs nas kyang gtso 'khor lhan cig 'gro ba las/ gtso bo gsum la ye shes pa bcug mi dgos pa'i dmigs bsal shes byed ci yang ma byung ba'i phyir dang*/ gzhan yang de nyid kyi sras kyi thu bo bstan pa'i snang byed chen po kun mkhyen bsod nams seng ge pas/ dbang chu'i rnam bshad du'ang*/ mgron bskyed pa ni/ chos 'byung sum brtsegs kyi steng ma la/ oṃ las sku rdo rje lha chen dang bcas pa bskyed/ bar pa la hūm̐ dgu las thugs rdo rje phyogs skyong brgyad dang bcas pa bskyed/ 'og ma la āḥdagu las gsung rdo rje klu chen brgyad dang bcas pa bskyed do// mgron dgug pa dang*/ skye mched dang sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlabs pa dang*/ ye shes kyi 'khor lo dgug gzhug dang dbang bskur nas rigs kyi bdag po'i rgyas gdab pa rnams bya/ de nas sngags tsam gyi chu bzhi phul nas zhes pa'i skabs kyang rdo rje gsum gyi lha tshogs thams cad dus gcig tu ye shes kyi 'khor lo dgug gzhug bya ba sogs yan lag bzhi tshang bar bshad kyis/ gtso bo gsum zur du bkar te bzhag pa ma gsungs pas kyang shes pa'i phyir/ gtor chog phrin las rgyas byed las/ ye shes pa bstim pa'i rjes su/ dam tshig pa thams cad ye shes pa'i ngo bo nyid du bsgyur te/ lha dang phyogs skyong dang klu rnams rim pa bzhin du sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rjer blta'o zhes pa'i don yang*/ mgron rigs gsum bskyed pa na rdo rje gsum gyi rnam pa can du bskyed la/ mgron dgug pa na steng gi lha thams cad lha chen brgyad la/ sa steng gi sems can thams cad phyogs skyong brgyad la/ sa 'og gi sems can thams cad klu chen brgyad la bstims pa'i tshe/ srid pa gsum gyi 'byung po rnams rang rang gi gzugs kyi rnam pa can du bstim pa yin la/

de'i tshe gtso bo gsum la bstim rgyu med kyang*/ byin gyis brlabs pa na/ sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' thams cad rdo rje gsum gyi rnam par spyan drangs nas bstims pas/ srid pa gsum gyi 'byung po rnams dang bcas pa'i gtso 'khor thams cad la bstims pas ye shes pa'i ngo bo nyid du bsgyur nus pa yin gyi/ 'byung po nyer bzhi kho na'i rang gzugs kyis bstim pa la rdo rje gsum du gyur par blta ru ga la yod/ rnam pa gcig tu na sangs rgyas byang sems thams cad ye shes pa rdo rje gsum gyi rnam par spyan drangs pa de 'khor rnams la min pa/ gtso bo la bstim du mi rung ba'i shes byed ci zhig yod/ des na 'don brjod la/ rje rdo rje 'chang gi gsung bzhin du/ phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i lha tshogs kyi rnam par oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes brjod na shin tu legs pa zhig 'byung ngo*// gal te de ltar na/ mdun bskyed gtor chog skabs thugs rdo rje gang du bstim snyam na/ spyan 'dren pa'i dus nas tshig de ltar brjod cing ye shes pa rnams spyan drangs nas/ sngags dang phyag rgya dmigs pa dang bcas pas bstim pa na thugs rdo rje'i ye shes pa/ gtso bo snying po kye rdo rje la bstims pa la ni 'gal ba cung zad kyang yod snyam mi sems te de ni rdo rje gsum gyi bdag nyid du gyur pa'i phyir/ tshogs mang lta bur 'don brjod de bzhin ma 'grigs par gyur na'ang*/ 'byung po brgyad gsum nyi shu rtsa bzhi zhes brjod pa'i tshe gtso bo gsum yang dmigs pas zin pa gal che'o// der ma zad gtor ma 'bul ba na'ang dogs pa 'di ltar snang ste/ dbang chu chen por gtor sngags la/ kā ya wāk+tsit+ta yan chad mi dgos zhes gsungs pa'i don la mkhas pa kha cig sku gsung thugs kye rdo rje gsum po ni 'byung po nyer bzhi'i gnya' non gyi tshul du bskyed pa yin gyi/

gtor ma mi 'bul bar bzhed pa yod kyang de ni rang lugs la mi 'thad pa ni/ gnad kyi gsal byed las/ chos 'byung gru gsum gyi nang gru bzhi pa byas nas/ de la le tshe dgur byas pa'i dbus ma la/ 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dkyil 'khor dang*/ le tshe brgyad la zhing skyong chung ma dang bcas bzhi bcu rtsa brgyad kyi tshom bu bkod cing bskyed nas/ gtor ma 'bul ba'i tshe 'jig rten 'das pa la phyi mchod nang mchod gtor ma bcas phul ba'i rjes su/ de ltar bdud rtsi sbyar ba'i lhag ma de gtor mar blugs la gtor ma bdud rtsir byin gyis brlabs/ de'i phud nas kyang ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor de nyid la dbul bar bya'o// de'i lhag mas mchod par bya ba la sogs pa bshad pas/ 'dir sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje gsum la'ang gtor ma'i phud 'bul ba gsal te/ zhing skyong bzhi bcu rtsa brgyad kyi gtor sngags la le tshe dbus ma'i gtor sngags med kyang phud le tshe dbus ma la 'bul bar gsungs pa'i phyir ro// des na rtsa rgyud kyi skabs 'dir lha dang 'byung po tha mi dad kyi gtor ma'i tshe gtor sngags gnyis char dang*/ 'byung po rkyang pa'i gtor ma'i tshe/ 'jig rten pa'i gtor sngags kho na brjod kyang phud 'das pa la 'bul ba rje btsun rtse mo'i dgongs par snang bas tshul 'di gzhan la'ang sbyar bar bya'o// des na gnad kyi gsal byed kyi lung 'dis 'jig rten pa'i tshul ston pa'i dgos pa dang*/ de la phyag mchod dang lhag mas sbyin pa gnyis ka mi 'gal ba'i tshul gsal bar gsungs pa 'di'ang deng sang gi rdo rje 'dzin pa rnams kyis nges par mdzad du gsol zhes kun mkhyen bsod nams seng ges gsungs so// des na phyi rol gtor ma'i tshe/ bha ga wān sogs gtso bo gsum gyi mtshan sngags med kyang gtor ma'i phud kyis mchod dgos par gsal lo// yang dri ba gnang bar/ mngon rtogs mdzes rgyan dang rnam bshad zla zer gnyis ka nas/

thun 'gor mchod gtor gyi rnal 'byor 'gro dgos par bshad kyang phyag len la mi mdzad pa dang*/ dag pa dran pa'i skabs bcom ldan 'das ni chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes sogs 'don byar mi mdzad pa ji ltar phebs par/ lan 'bul ba la/ thun 'gor mchod gtor gyi rnal 'byor bya ba ni/ thun mtshams kyi bya ba zhes kyang bya/ mchod gtor gyi rnal 'byor zhes kyang bya/ las dang po pa'i bya ba zhes kyang bya/ phyi rol tshogs bsag gi rnal 'byor zhes kyang bya ste/ rnal 'byor dbang phyug gi man ngag mnyam par ma bzhag pa'i rnal 'byor brgyad kyi nang gsel te/ kye rdo rje 'di nyid kho na'i rnal 'byor gtso bor 'dzin pa zhig gis phyag len mdzad rgyu yin la/ de ji ltar nyams su len pa la/ mchod bsham gyi bya ba/ dkyil 'khor gyi bya ba/ tshogs zhing spyan drang ba'i bya ba/ phyag 'tshal ba/ mchod pa dbul ba/ rgyun bshags bya ba/ sdom pa gzung ba/ gtor ma btang ba ste brgyad kyi sgo nas nges pa/ da lta'i ngor bskang gi dbu nas 'byung ba ltar yin mod/ deng sang de bzhin mi nus pa rnams kyis mnyam gzhag gi rnal 'byor dngos min par/ thun mtshams kyi bya ba'am/ lam gyi yan lag tsam du bsams nas/ dper na bsam gtan gyi grogs su 'gro na khrus bya/ grogs su ma song na ma byas kyang mi 'gal zhes pa lta bu'i rigs 'grer song ba 'dra zhig yin nam snyam pa ma gtogs/ rnal 'byor bcu par na ched du nyams su len pa la dgos pa'i chos yin pas/ phyag len du gtan mi mdzad pa ni ma yin te/ tshogs bsags kyi rnal 'byor du phan yon che ba zhig go /dag pa dran pa'i skabs/ bcom ldan 'das ni chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes sogs tshig lhug pa 'di mi 'don pa ni/ phyogs 'ga' re zhig tu srid mod/ thams cad du ni min pa 'dra ste/ 'di 'don byar mi mdzad pa'i rgyu mtshan ma rnyed pa rnams kyis ni da ltar 'don bzhin pa'ang mang du snang zhing*/

khyad par 'di nyid 'don byar ma byas na/ phyi'i dkyil 'khor gyi rten dang brten par bcas pa'i rnam dag kyang mi 'byung ste/ ji skad du/ mchog la dag pa dran pa khyad par ro// zhes mchog gi dngos grub sgrub par dag pa nyid la go rtogs rnyed pa gtso che bar bzhed pa'i phyir/ de'ang rtsa rgyud las/ de ltar 'khor ba 'dod pa yi// yon tan lnga ldan rin po che// ma dag pas na dug tu 'gyur// dag pas bdud rtsi lta bur 'gyur// zhes sogs gzhi lam 'bras bu'i chos su snang ba thams cad 'khor 'das dbyer med du shes pa'i bdag med rtogs pa'i shes rab bskyed pa nyid shin tu gal che ste/ spyod 'jug las/ yan lag 'di dag thams cad ni// thub pas shes rab don du gsungs// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ dag pa gzhan rnams phal cher ni rang gi lus kyi phung khams skye mched sogs dang sbyar ba shas che ba'i phyir/ des na 'di dag mi brjod pa de ni/ gzhan shes rlom pa 'ga' zhig 'di spro na brjod/ mi spro na'ang ma brjod kyang chog pa yin zhes pa lta bus sgros ngan smra ba zhig gi ngag rgyun mched pa zhig yin las che snyam ste/ 'di ma brjod na phyi'i dkyil 'khor gyi rten dang brten pa'i dag dran mi 'byung ba'i phyir ro// yang dri ba gnang bar/ bum pa dang bdag 'jug skabs kyi dbang lha'i mchod pa blo rtse gang la gtod ces phebs par/ lan 'bul ba ni/ 'di dag la gong ma rnams kyis bsham gyi skabs nas de dag gi mchod pa bsham dgos par ma gsungs pa dang*/ 'bul ba'i sngon du byin rlabs bya ba bcas ma bshad pas bum pa'i mchod pa ni/ mdun bskyed kyi spyi mchod la dmigs na chog pa yin nam snyam ste/ rgyu mtshan mdun bskyed dang bum pa'i lha gnyis ka'ang kye rdo rje lha dgu lta bu bskyed gzhi tha dad pas min pa 'bul yul gyi lha gcig par song bas spyi mchod la dmigs pas grub par rigs te/ dkyil 'khor la brten pa'i dbang thams cad dang byin rlabs rjes gnang bum pa bsgrub dgos pa yod pa thams cad du nyer spyod lhag po bsham srol mi 'byung ba'i phyir/

dper na gsang sngags rnying ma'i lugs 'ga' re na'ang bdag mdun bum pa gsum ga bskyed chog gcig gis bskyed nas/ mchod pa 'bul chog kyang gcig gis thams cad la 'bul ba'i mos pas khyab par byed dgos pa yod pa ltar/ 'dir yang bskyed chog snga phyi'i khyad par tsam min pa mchod pa spyi mchod la dmigs te 'bul du mi rung ba med pa'i phyir snyam mo// bdag 'jug dbang lha la mchod pa 'bul ba 'ga' re min pa mi 'byung yang*/ bdag 'jug dbang lha'i lha mo rnams kyis rang la rig pa'i dbang sogs re re rdzogs mtshams nas 'bul ba de la dgongs pas yin na/ slob ma gzhug dus mchod pa dngos bsham byed pa ma gtogs/ bdag 'jug la mchod pa dang dbang rdzas phal cher yid kyis sprul pas byed pa shas cher yod pas/ mchod pa'ang de mtshungs lags so// yang dri ba gnang bar/ dkyil chog rnams su/ gtor ma la bar phud bran par gsungs pa de'ang*/ sta gon las/ dngos gzhi rnams mi bran pa 'dra zhig 'dug pa de'i khyad par ji ltar dang*/ gshed dmar sbyin sreg tu gtor ma thams cad la bran par gsungs pa kun la mtshungs min ji ltar lags zhes phebs par/ lan 'bul ba ni/ sgrub mchod sta gon dang*/ sbyin sreg cho ga'i nyi ma dang po rnams su phud mchod 'bul ba na/ bla ma yi dam rang lus kyi lha rnams mchod zin nas/ chos skyong man chad kyi sngon du nang mchod bar phud blangs te gtor ma la bran pa 'di/ chos srung nas rigs drug bar du byin pa'i nang mchod kyi lhag ma des/ yi dam sogs kyi gtor mar bran na lhag mar 'gyur bar dgongs nas/ de ltar mi 'gyur ba'i ched du/ bar gyi phud de ma nyams pa'i gong nas bran pa yin zhing*/ des na dngos gzhi'am nyin gnyis pa man chad nas bran mi dgos te/ kha sang gi gtor ma yod pa de la bar phud song yod pa'i don gyis so// yang dri ba gnang bar/ dkon mchog lhun grub kyis mdzad pa'i sbyin sreg dang*/

dpal ldan don grub pas mdzad pa'i sbyin sreg gi rnam bshad gnyis su/ byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya cung zad mi mthun zhing*/ dpal grub pa'i de ltar na/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i khu tshur la g.yon pa'i mdzub mo bsgreng ba las/ g.yas pa'i mdzub mo mi bsgreng ba 'dra zhig snang ba/ 'dir mdzad pa'i phyag len dang cung ma mthun pa ji ltar zhes phebs par/ de'i lan ni/ rigs lnga'i nang nas de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi khu tshur ram/ byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya zhes bya ba ni/ rigs lnga'i sprul bshad dus kyi rnam snang gi phyag rgya dang*/ sa skya paṇ+ḍi tas/ phung po gsum pa 'don pa'i thabs las kyang*/ dkar po bdun ni byang chub mchog gi phyag rgya zhes pa rnams kyi phyag rgya 'ching tshul ni/ lag pa g.yon pa'i khu tshur gyi mdzub mo bsgrengs pa de/ g.yas pa'i khu tshur gyis bsdams pa tsam bshad kyis/ g.yas pa'i mdzub mo bsgreng dgos pa ma bshad de/ lam 'bras bla ma rigs lngar bsgom pa'i skabs kyi zin ris/ sa paṇa gyi slob ma dmar yin nam snyam pa tsam las/ deng dus yid la ma nges pa zhig tu/ rnam snang gi phyag rgya de lta bu 'cha' ba'i dgos pa ni/ lus kyi g.yon na byang chub kyi sems 'bab pa'i rtsa yod pa/ de mtshon pas g.yon pa'i mdzub mo bsgreng ba yin la/ byang sems de nyid phyir mi 'pho bar lus kyis rtag tu 'ching bar byed pa mtshon phyir g.yas pa'i khu tshur gyis de bcing bar byed pa'i don du yin par bshad do// des na sbyin sreg gi dus su'ang g.yon pa'i khu tshur mdzub mo bsgreng ba dang bcas pas dgang gzar gzung mod/ g.yas pa khu tshur bcang bas blugs gzar gzung ba nyid 'thad par mngon no// yang dri ba gnang bar/ rgyud gsum gyi/ rlung gi gzhu la me yi mda'// byang sems haṃ gyis 'ben la brdeg /myur du ye shes skye bar 'gyur// skyar ba'i sbyor ba med pa'o// zhes pa'i tshig 'dir/ smin gling lo chen gyis sdom gsum 'grel par/

ma mo'i rgyud la yod pa las/ kye rdor rgyud gsum gang la'ang mi bzhugs zer ba rtsod pa ji ltar spong zhes par/ lan 'bul ba ni/ sdom gsum 'grel pa de/ de sngon ma mthong yang*/ rang bzhin gyis de ltar mthong tshul brjod pa tsam las rtsod pa min las che zhing*/ ma mo'i rgyud du tshig de 'dra zhig yod na'ang*/ gsar rnying gi rgyud sde rnams su lha dang sngags dang bskyed rdzogs kyi bsgom tshul rjod byed kyi tshig 'dra ba tsam mang du 'byung yang*/ de dang de nyid nas yin par brgyud pa bar ma chad pa las byung ba'i lo rgyus bcas yod dgos shing*/ khyad par tshig de nyid la brten pa'i man ngag gi rgyun snyan brgyud tshad ma bzhi dang ldan pa zhig shing rta chen po dpal ldan rnal 'byor dbang phyug yab sras rnams kyis gsan pa'i lo rgyus bcas yod dgos/ de med na 'dra ba yod tshul tsam rang dgar smras pas phan gnod kyi 'bras bu ci yang 'byin mi nus pa'i phyir/ kye rdo rje'i rgyud gsum ga na mi bzhugs zhes pa'ang kha tshon gcod ga la nus te/ dper na/ brtag pa drug pa'i rab byed gsum par/ rkang pa'i mthil du gnas pa'i rlung*// rtsom pa chen po gzhu yi dbyibs// zhes bya ba dang*/ las kyi rlung gis bskul ba yis// las la bcom ldan shes rab spyod// ces bya ba dang*/ brtag pa dang po'i rab tu byed par/ chos dbyings khu bar byas nas ni// zhes bya ba lta bu rgyud sde rnams las bsdus tsam bstan pa la/ mkhas shing grub pa'i bla ma rnams kyi man ngag gis bkral bar ma byas na nyams su mi lon pa mang du yod pa'i phyir/ des na/ rlung gi gzhu la me yi mda'// zhes sogs tshangs pa'i thog ces pa sogs lnga'i nang tshan rgyud kyi lung de dag la brten nas byas pa'ang man ngag gi tshigs bcad yin par bshad kyis/ rgyud kyi tshig yin par ma smras so// gal te ma mo'i rgyud du tshig de 'dra yod na'ang*/ snga phyi'i sngags log sun 'byin rnams su bshad tshul ltar na 'phags yul du rgyud de 'dra'i rigs bzhugs pa dang nyan bshad kyi srol byas pa'i nges pa'ang ma mchis pa ltar na/

de nyid rnam par bkral ba las byung ba'i man ngag brgyud ldan yod min ji ltar yang dpyad byar snang ngo*// yang dri bar/ klu gtor sogs klu'i bskyed chog skabs yul gyi dbang po sna tshogs su snang ba zhes pa'i go don gang lags zhes phebs par/ lan 'bul ba ni/ 'di la 'di yin gyi bshad pa byas pa de sngon ma mthong yang*/ ji skad du/ legs par bshad pa rin po che'i gter las/ blo dang ldan la ma smras kyang*// rnam 'gyur nyid la bsam pas go /bal po se'u ma zos kyang*// kha dog nyid las bro ba shes// zhes pa ltar rnam par dpyad na/ kha dog dag pa'i shel ltar dwangs shing*/ yul gyi dbang po sna tshogs su snang ba zhes pa/ klu rnams kyi lus ye shes kyi snang ba lta bu zhig ni ga la yod kyang*/ las las grub pa'i gzugs shel ltar dag pa la/ rgya mtsho'am chu'i nang nas thon ma thag pa'i rlan dang bcas pa de la/ phyi rol don du snang ba'i gzugs kyi bkod pa gang dang phrad pa de'i gzugs la gzugs brnyan sna tshogs 'char ba'i 'os kyang yin te/ dper na me long shin tu dwangs pa'i ngos su nyan skor du snang ba'i gzugs gang la bstan yang mi 'char ba med pa'am/ mi gcig gi mig 'bras dwangs pa gnyis su nyan skor du 'khod pa'i mi gang gis bltas kyang de dang de'i gzugs brnyan rnams 'gog pa med par 'char ba de lta bu zhig 'byung ba de la brjod pa yin nam snyam/ 'on kyang yul gyi dbang po zhes pa'i tshig 'dir da dung cung zad dpyad byar snang ste/ yul gyi rnam pa sna tshogs su snang ba zhes pa zhig yod na der som nyi 'jug dgos gtan ma mchis mod/ yul gyi dbang po zhes byas na gzugs sogs yul mchog tu gyur pa min pa gzugs phal pa dang dman pa'i yul rnams mi 'char ba lta bu'am/ yang na yul gzugs dang yul can dbang por bcas par 'char ba lta bu'i tshig 'di brjod tshul ma legs pa'am ma dag pa sogs ci yin cung zad 'phyang mo nyug go

/ji ltar zhe na/ snga ma ltar na tshig 'di brjod ma legs pa zhig min na/ dper na mig gi dkyil na mi gzugs rnams 'char ba ma gtogs gzugs gzhan mi snang ba ltar/ 'di la'ang las kyi dbang gis gzugs yid du 'ong ba min pa/ mi sdug pa'i gzugs mi snang ba tsam brgya lam na yod pa'ang srid mod/ de ltar na'ang sna tshogs zhes pa'i tshig grogs 'di yul mchog dman bzang ngan sna tshogs su 'chad dgos pas na cung zad skyon du mi 'gyur ba med la/ phyi ma ltar na rigs pas gtan nas mi 'grub pa nyid do// yang dri ba gnang bar/ nyid kyis mdzad pa'i sngags kyi klog thabs rnam gsal sgron me'i nang nas/ gsal byed rnams ni sum cu bdun// zhes pa'i mchan bur ka nas ha'i bar zhes snang ba de la so bdun ma tshang ba cung zad thugs g.yel ba yin las che zhes phebs par/ lan 'bul ba ni/ de'ang brda sprod pa'i mdo ka lā pa las/ ka la sogs pa rnams gsal byed do// aḥzhes rnam par gcad bya'o// ྈka zhes pa lce rtsa can no// ny+pa zhes pa mchu can no// aṃ zhes pa rjes su nga ro'o// zhes 'byung ba ltar te/ ka sde nas pa sde'i bar lnga tshan lnga ste nyi shu rtsa lnga/ ya ra la wa ste mthar gnas bzhi/ sha ṣa sa ha ste dro ba'i yi ge bzhi'i bar te/ so gsum dang*/ aḥzhes pa'i rnam gcad kyi yi ge dang*/ ྈka zhes pa'i ḍā ma ru'i yi ge dang*/ ny+pa zhes pa mchu can gyi yi ge dang*/ aṃ zhes pa rjes su nga ro'i yi ge zhes bya ba/ de rnams kyi'ang a gnyis dang ka pa rnams nges bzung gi don yin pas mi bsngo na'ang*/ rnam par gcad bya la sogs pa'i yi ge bzhi bsnan pas sum cu rtsa bdun du 'gyur bar sgra 'grel rnams su bshad pa ltar smras pa lags so// yang dri ba gnang bar/ sa 'og rim pa bdun gyi/ gzhi dang rnam gzhi sogs kyi ngos 'dzin ji ltar zhes phebs par/ de'i lan na/ mnan pa sogs kyi skabs nas 'khor lo'i phyag rgya dral te sa rim pa bdun gas pa'i gseb nas gshin rje thon par bsam zhes 'byung yang*/

de'i ngos 'dzin 'di yin de sngon ma nges shing*/ rdo rje gdan bzhi'i sgrub thabs kyi skabs nas gzhi dang sogs kyi tshigs bcad de tsam min pa'i rgyas bshad ma byung mod/ gzhan du gzhi dang rnam gzhi sogs kyi don sa gzhi kho na la sbyar ba zhig yod na legs mod/ de ltar ma yin pa'i 'jig rten khams gzhan re re bzhin rgyas par bshad pa zhig yod song na/ de'i rim bdun de las kyi gshin rje'i gnas dang sbyar du mi btub par sems te/ las kyi gshin rje'i gnas ni/ la li ta badz+ras mdzad pa'i sgrub thabs dang*/ mngon pa mdzod sogs kyi bshad tshul mi mthun pa med de/ ji skad du/ 'chi ba yi dwags rgyal po ni// ma dros mtsho yi 'bri mig nas// ri nag dgu yi pha mtha' ste// spos ngad ri bo'i bar dag na// chu dang zheng du cha mnyam mtsho// de 'og dpag tshad lnga brgya'i gnas// 'chi ba yi dwags rgyal po'i gnas// 'gro ba'i ltag pa'i phyogs na gnas// zhes dang*/ phung po nying mtshams sbyor ba yis// 'jigs pa de yi gzugs mthong nas// gshin rje de yi dri ngan 'byung*// des na rang gi srog gi bdag /ltag pa'i phyogs na gnas pa ste// gtsigs pa can la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes gsungs pa ltar/ phyi'i gnas ni gshin rje rang rgyud pa'i gnas dang mthun par mtsho ma dros pa'i 'og dpag tshad lnga brgya'i sa na yod cing*/ nang du skye 'gro'i ltag khung na lus dang grib ma'i tshul du snang ba/ phung po nying mtshams sbyor ba'i tshe/ 'chi bdag tu 'gyur ba de yin par 'gyur la/ tshul de dang mthun par/ 'jig rten gzhag pa dang mngon pa mdzod sogs las kyang*/ 'dzam bu'i gling nas dpag tshad lnga brgya'i 'og na yi dwags kyi gnas gzhi chen por gshin rje chos kyi rgyal po sems can rnams kyi dge sdig gi stong gcod cing gnas par bshad do// 'o na spyan 'dren gyi skabs su/ 'di nas lho yi phyogs rol nas// dpag tshad brgyad khri'i pha rol na// zhes 'byung ba ji ltar drangs zhe na/

de ni sgrub pa po gang du gnas pa'i sa de nas rten 'brel gyi dbang gis lho phyogs su dpag tshad brgyad khri gzhal ba'i pha rol du yi dwags kyi gnas yod pa'i dbang du byas te/ de nas spyan 'dren par bshad kyi/ dpag tshad brgyad khri 'og tu gzhal ba nas spyan 'dren par ma bshad mod/ de la'ang 'og tu dpag tshad lnga brgya'i tshad yin pa la ni khyad par med pa'i phyir/ gal te de ltar yin na bskul ba'i 'gor/ rgya mtsho chen po'i gting rum nas// dpag tshad brgyad khri 'das pa'i 'og /rgya gram rlung gi bar dag nas// gshin rje ya ma rā dza ni// zhes 'byung ba ji ltar mthun snyam na/ de ni gong ma kun dang mi mthun pas/ tshig rkang bzhi po de ma brtags par bab col du smras pa'i tshig tu mngon te/ ci'i phyir na/ theg pa thun mong ba'i lugs la/ mdzod las/ 'di 'og stong phrag nyi shu na// mnar med pa'o// zhes 'byung ba ltar/ 'dzam bu'i gling gi 'og tu thur la dpag tshad nyi khri 'das pa na/ sems can dmyal ba chen po mnar med ces bya ba tsha dmyal kun gyi sdug bsngal mthar thug pa de yod par bshad la/ de las kyang thur la dpag tshad mang po bgrang ba'i sa na yi dwags kyi gnas yod par ni sus kyang bshad pa med pa'i phyir dang*/ rgya mtsho chen po'i gting rum zhes pa phyi'i rgya mtsho'i gting rum yin dgos la/ de ltar yin na/ de'i 'og tu 'og gzhi rlung rdo rje rgya gram zhes bya ba rngams su dpag tshad sa ya drug 'bum yod pa'i steng nas kyang thur du dpag tshad brgyad khri dbri bas rlung gi rngams la sa ya lnga dgu 'bum nyi khri las mi lus pa'i rlung gi dkyil 'khor gyi dbus na yi dwags kyi gnas yod par 'dod pa sngon chad ma grags pa'i gtam du snang la/ gal te phyi'i rgya mtsho ma yin par gser gyi sa gzhi'i steng na 'khyil pa'i rgya mtsho'i gting rum yin du bcug na'ang*/ de yan chad du'ang ri rab lhun po'i smad cha chu mtshams nas thur du dpag tshad brgyad yod pa/

de mi brtsi bar rgya mtsho'i gting rum ste/ gser gyi sa gzhi man chad du dpag tshad brgyad khri gzhal dgos na/ dbang chen gser gyi sa gzhi'i rngams su dpag tshad sum 'bum dang nyi khri yod pa'i nang nas kyang*/ dpag tshad brgyad khri dbri bas sa gzhi la nyis 'bum bzhi khri las mi lus pa'i mtshams der yi dwags kyi gnas yod pa gad mo'i gnas so// yang bshad tshul gzhan dang mi mthun na yang*/ nang rdo rje'i lus kyi gnas tshul du sbyar ba dus kyi 'khor lo las ni/ rlung gi mtha' nas lhun po'i bar du dmyal ba'i gnas bdun dang brgyad pa ni gdengs can gyi grong khyer du bshad pa la ni/ rlung me chu sa'i dkyil 'khor bzhi bsdams par dpag tshad 'bum phrag gnyis yin pa las/ rlung gi dkyil 'khor la dpag tshad stong phrag lnga bcur yod pa'i phyed 'og ma la dpag tshad stong phrag nyer lngar drag po'i rlung chen po dang de steng nyer lngar mun pa chen po zhes pa 'og mar ngu 'bod chen po dang*/ steng mar dmyal ba'i gnas gnyis steng 'og tu gnas pa sogs bshad pa de dag dang yang mi 'grigs te/ rlung de la rgya gram gyi ming du bshad pa med kyang*/ gal te de la rgya gram rlung gi bar zhes ngos bzung na yang*/ dpag tshad brgyad khri zhes pa'i grangs 'grigs par mi 'gyur te/ rlung gi dkyil 'khor yan chad kyi me chu sa'i dkyil 'khor la 'bum phrag phyed gnyis yod dgos pa'i phyir/ des na rgya mtsho chen po'i gting rum zhes pa'i tshig rkang bzhi po 'di ni blun po gzu lum can zhig gis sbyar ba som nyi ci zhig de man chad kyi tshigs bcad rnams ni sngar zhus ltar tshad ldan gzung rung du mchis so// 'o na tshig rkang bzhi po de slan chad bsgyur bkod 'dra byed na ji ltar bgyi zhe na/ de'i tshab tu/ bcom ldan rdo rje 'jigs byed kyis// bstan pa srung ba gnyer gtad pa'i// bka' sdod skye 'gro'i srog gi bdag

/gshin rje'i rgyal po zhes bya ba// sku mdog mthing nag 'bar ba sogs sngar bzhin brjod pas brling bar sems te/ de dag ni 'phros tsam mo// de nyid la bka' 'dri gnang ba'i dngos gzhi rim pa bdun gyi ngos 'dzin yang kho bo ni rje btsun rin po che grags pas mdzad pa'i sgrol bstod kyi 'grel par/ 'jig rten bdun po zhabs kyis mnan te// zhes pa dang*/ rim pa bdun po rnams ni 'gems ma// zhes pa 'di gnyis ka la/ 'dod khams kyi 'gro ba lnga dang*/ gzugs khams dang drug gzugs med khams te bdun/ bshad pa nyid 'thad par sems te/ de ni sgrol ma 'jig rten bdun las rnam par rgyal ba'i don nam/ hūm̐ gi sgras 'jig rten rim pa bdun po skrag par byed pa'am/ khams gsum du 'dzin pa'i rtog pa 'joms pa'i don du dgongs so// des na rim pa bdun ni/ 'jig rten rim pa bdun te/ 'dod pa'i khams lnga ni/ ngan 'gro gsum

3 / mi dang 4 */ lha ni rgyal chen ris bzhi nas 'phrul dga' bar lnga 5 / gzugs khams ni tshangs ris nas 'og min bar te drug 6 dang*/ gzugs med khams nam mkha' mtha' yas nas yod min med min ba 7 ra te 'jig rten bdun po de dag gi 'og na yod pas sa 'og rim pa bdun te/ dmyal ba'i gong du yi dwags kyi gnas yod dgos na'ang*/ dmyal ba na'ang dge sdig gi stongs 'dzin pa sogs kyis khyab pa la dgongs par sems so// des na de dag dang ngos 'dzin byas nas bsgrigs na 'grigs par 'gyur gyi/ gzhan du gzhi dang rnam gzhi zhes pa de dag kyang rim pa bdun gyi ngos 'dzin byas pa yod rung*/ lung de nyid bla ma snga ma zhig gis kyang sa 'og rim pa bdun du grags/ zhes gsungs pa de nyid la dpyad pa ma zhugs par lung 'dren gyi skabs nor ba 'dra zhig byung ba de ltar du mkhan chen bud+dha lak+ṣ+mīs kyang lung drangs pa yin nam snyam ste/ ci'i phyir zhe na/ de dag 'og nas 'og tu sangs rgyas sprul pa'i sku bzhugs pa'i zhing khams gzhi zhes bya ba dang rnam gzhi zhes bya ba sogs rim pa bdun yod pa lta bu yin pa shas che bar snang bas/ de ltar na sgrol mas sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams bdun zhabs kyis mnan pa dang 'gems par byed pa'i 'os med pa'i phyir dang*/ las kyi gshin rje'i gnas kyang 'jig rten pa'i mthun snang ltar gshin rje rang rgyud pa'i gnas gling bzhi pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams zhig yin dgos te/ ston pas rgyud gsungs pa na'ang*/ gdul bya'i gtso bo gshin rje yin pa la dgongs nas/ lho phyogs gshin rje'i grong khyer chen por 'dul ba'i thabs kyang*/ gshin rje'i gzugs kyis 'dul bar dgongs nas der gshegs pa'i tshul bstan pa'ang gshin rje rang rgyud pa'i bsti gnas su ngos 'dzin dgos pa'i phyir ro// yang dri bar/ rgyal dbang lnga pa chen po'i gsung de'i lan/ zhal gsal zhig byung na snyam pa rnams thugs rjes ma bor bar dgos tshul phebs par/

de dag gi skor sngar gyi gsung lan du phul ba der thugs dpyad stsal bas ha lam dogs pa sel nus tsam yod pas des 'thus shing*/ de las rgyas pa rnam bshad 'dra ba'i skabs yin na min pa re zhig skabs su ma phyin pas gzhag go /de dag gis ni dpyod ldan dam pa nyid nas bka' 'dri rig byed 'byin po'i gdangs snyan gyi rjes 'gror stsal ba'i lan gsal de 'phral nas 'bul dgos yod pa gor ma chag na'ang*/ de dag gi skabs su kho bo lta byed kyi dbang po dang*/ 'dri byed kyi sug pa la'ang nye zho'i bro 'tshal cung zad byung nas 'bul ma thub par/ 'di lor bdag cag rnams kyi ston pas kyang*/ bsregs bcad brdar ba'i gser bzhin du// legs par brtags la nga yi bka'// blang bar bya yi gus phyir min// zhes gsungs pa ltar/ ston pa nyid kyi gsung la legs par brtag 'os su gsungs pa ltar/ cung zad dpyad pa 'dir rjes 'jug gi dpyod ldan la'ang phan pa dang*/ chos kyi byi dor du mi 'gro ba ci zhig yod kyang*/ gna' bo'i srol la zhen pa'i zol can rnams kyi rnar mi snyan na'ang*/ rnam par dpyod ldan nyid dgyes bar 'gyur slad lan ldon legs bris me tog dkar po'i sil mas 'thor ba re zhig bris zin to// 'dir smras pa/ bdag ni bka' lung dgongs 'grel legs bris yul// bla mar 'degs pa'i dad stobs brling ba tsam// rin chen lhun po'i grags snyan la chags pa'i// mkhas rlom gnyis skyes gser du snang ba'i rgyus// tshul mthong blo yang 'phags pa'i blo gros su// rnam par brtags pa gang zhig rgyang ring nas// dgos skabs chos kyi dka' gnas la la zhig /'dri byed mi 'gyur phreng ba cang 'byor ba// gtan 'dun chos la mi dpyod the tshom gnas// mi shes mi rmad sbed pa blun po'i skyon// dogs gnas phra mos thams cad mkhyen lam gyi// sgrib par rtogs nas 'dri ba mkhas pa'i tshul// de slad dpyod ldan mchog nas bka' stsal don// gang dran rtse 'jo'i lan ldon me tog btus// rjod byed tshar du dngar 'di stobs bcu mnga'// sras bcas bstan par mdzes pa'i rgyan du 'bul// 'di bgyis dge bas brtse chen e waṃ pa// zung gi lugs bzang gaṅgās 'dzam gling khyon// yongs gang mkhas grub bye ba'i ngang pas rtsen// bshad sgrub mgrin snyan phyogs bcur sgrogs par shog

/ces dgos skabs chos kyi bka' gnas kyi dogs pa 'dri ba'i lan ldon me tog phreng ba zhes bya ba 'di ni/ mkhas btsun bzang po'i yon tan gyi dbyig dang ldan pa rdo rje slob dpon ngag dbang shes rab pa'i gsung bskul 'jig rten mes po'i gdangs snyan lta bus 'byor bar/ rgyal ba gnyis pa rje btsun e waṃ pa yab sras brgyud par bcas pa'i legs gsungs kyi bdud rtsis 'tsho ba'i ban+de tshul khrims rin chen nam/ 'byung du rung ba'i yon tan la smon pa'i btags ming du/ ngag gi dbang po 'jigs bral phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i lha/ dbyangs can snyems pa'i lang tsho'i sde zhes bod pas/ sde dge lhun grub steng gi gtsug lag khang mthong na mngon par dga' ba'i nye 'dabs kyi rgyal khab tu bris nas phul ba swasti bi dza yan+tu// // ༄༅// nyams len skabs kyi dogs gnas dri ba 'ga' zhig byung ba'i lan ldon kun phan gzhon nu zhes bya ba bzhugs// ༄༅// gang zhig srid zhi'i mtha' chen gnyis 'gongs par// bla med gnas su phyin nas yid can tshogs// nges legs lam nas 'dren mdzad e waṃ pa// brgyud par bcas la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// sangs rgyas sgrub pa'i bden gnyis dbyer med kyi// lam bzang don du gnyer ba dge ba'i bshes// skye 'phags mkhas pa kun dga'i ring lugs bzang*// yongs 'dzin de yis drin lan cung zad blan// lam gsum rgyun gyis som nyi 'khrud nus min// snang gsal bteg pas dka' gnas gsal mi byed// de dag las ni lung rigs gdams pa'i mchid// yid ches bskyed la khyad par 'phags pa nyid// de'ang rim gnyis kyi rnal 'byor lhur len pa'i dge slong sangs rgyas kun bzang pa nyid nas/ rje btsun rin po ches/ dmigs med 'jigs dang bral ba'i skyabs su 'gro// tshad med dmigs yul spangs pa'i sems bskyed bya// de yi chos nyid rang bzhin nam mkha' 'dra// bsags pa med pa'i dge rtsa byang chub bsngo// zhes gsungs pa rnams rgyud la sbyar nas nyams su len tshul gyi gdams pa sbyor dngos rjes gsum tshang ba zhig dgos zhes par/

'dir go don gyi snye ma nyung bsdus tsam 'bul ba la/ dri ba dang po'i don spyir bstan pa dang*/ bye brag tu bstan pa gnyis las/ dang po ni/ spyir gong skyabs su 'gro ba nas mjug dge ba bsngo ba'i bar gyi sbyor dngos rjes kyi chos thams cad 'khor 'das dbyer med dam/ bden gnyis zung 'jug tu nyams su blang dgos kyi/ de dag ya bral gyi kun rdzob dmigs bcas kho na'am/ don dam stong nyid kho na bsgom du mi rung ste/ des ni yang dag pa'i lam du mi 'gyur te/ kun rdzob dmigs bcas su kho na bsgoms pa ni/ rnam par rtog pa'i mtshan mar 'dzin pa yin la/ de ni yang dag par sbyor bar/ rnam rtog ma rig chen po ste// 'khor ba'i rgya mtshor ltung byed yin// zhes dang*/ rje sa skya pa chen pos kyang*/ ye shes rnam par rtog pa yi// dbang du gyur na grol ba med// ces dang*/ chos nyid 'dzin pas dkris pa la// mi rtog pa yang 'khrul snang yin// de yis mi rtog bsgoms na yang*// rnam rtog mtshan ma'i 'khrul 'khor yin// zhes sogs rgya cher gsungs pas so// gal te stong nyid kho na bsgoms kyang mi grol te/ ji skad du sa skya paṇ+ḍi tas/ stong nyid nyan thos rnams kyang bsgoms// de yi 'bras bu 'gog pa thob// ces dang*/ sdud par/ thabs med shes rab bral bas nyan thos nyid du lhung*// zhes sogs 'byung ngo*// des na zung 'jug brjod bral blo 'das kyi ngang du nyams su len dgos te/ de nyid las/ kun rdzob ji ltar snang bzhin pas// don dam mtha' bzhi'i spros pa bral// zhes dang*/ rgyal sras sems dpa' chen pos/ rang bzhin med pa kun rdzob rang bzhin 'di// mtha' las 'das phyir nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam// rkyen las skyes phyir skye ba med pa ste// rten 'brel yin phyir rang gi ngo bos stong*// dam pa'i don ni spros pa'i mtha' dang bral// smra bsam brjod las 'das pa'i ye shes kyis// 'ga' yang mthong med tshul gyis mthong ba yin// zhes bshad pa ltar/

kun rdzob rang sems bag chags 'khrul pa'i dbang gis phyi don du snang ba'i snod bcud 'khor 'das kyis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad rang sems de dang der snang ba tsam ste/ dper na rmi lam gyi snang ba lta bu/ sems snang de dag thams cad kyang sgyu ma mkhan gyis sprul pa'i rta dang glang po grong khyer la sogs pa lta bu/ sgyu ma'i snang ba lta bu de dag kyang rten cing 'brel par 'byung ba brjod du med par shes pa'i shes rab kyi dbang pos dpyad ngor/ yod med yin min gang du'ang grub pa med par sems nyid rang snang ba yin te/ sems nyid kyi rang bzhin ni rgyu rkyen gang gis kyang ma bskyed pa'i phyir dang po skye bas stong*/ skye ba med pas sdod pa med pa'i phyir bar du gnas pas stong*/ mi gnas pa nyid la 'jig pa med pas mthar 'gags pa med de/ mdor na yin min dang*/ yod med gcig dang du ma sogs gang du yang grub pa med par shes pa'i dmigs pa med pa ni rnam par mi rtog pa ste/ ji skad du/ mi rtog ting 'dzin la gnas na// mkha' bzhin dri ma med par 'gyur// zhes so// de'ang las dang po pas mtshan 'dzin gyi dmigs pa dang bcas pa ltar 'gyur yang*/ de nyid snang stong gi tshul dran pa nan tan du byas pas mi rtog par skye ba 'byung ste/ gang gi phyir na/ dmigs pa la ni brten nas ni// mi dmigs pa ni rab tu skye// zhes 'byung ba dang*/ khyad par bskyed rim la sogs pa gang bsgom yang*/ rgyu dus kyi lta bas zin par bsgom dgos te/ rgyu mtshan bskyed rim nyid rnam rtog yin mod/ rtog pa'i ngo bo ni rang sems nyid yin la/ sems de'i yon tan gyi ldog pa'i cha nas dbye na/ sems kyi mtshan nyid gsal ba gsal rig gsal rig gi rang bzhin stong pa yin zhing*/ stong pa ni chos dbyings yin la/ 'khrul rtog thams cad chos dbyings su dag par rtogs pa 'byung ba'i phyir/ de ni mi dmigs pa'am mi rtog pa'i ye shes nyid yin te/

rje sa skya pa chen pos/ rnam par rtog pa ye shes kyi// dbang du gyur na 'khor ba med// ces dang*/ 'khor ba btsal bas ma rnyed pa// mya ngan 'das pa'i rang bzhin yin// 'khor 'das med par go ba de// 'khor 'das dbyer med kyi lta ba yin// zhes sogs rgya cher 'byung ngo*// rgyu dus kyi lta bas zin dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan yang*/ saṃ pu ṭa las/ dang por stong nyid bsgoms nas ni// lus can kun gyi dri ma bkru// lus sogs stong pa'i zhing sa la// blo dang ldan pas sa bon gdab// ces gsungs pa'i don la dgongs nas/ rang re'i lam 'bras sogs kyi skabs su lta ba dbang gi rjes su bstan pa dang*/ bskyed rdzogs bsgom pa'i sngon du bstan pa'ang 'og nas 'byung ba'i lam thams cad kyang de dang der snang tsam rang gi ngo bor skye 'gag gnas gsum gyi spros pa thams cad dang bral ba rtogs nas/ mdor na gzhi lam 'bras bu'i chos su snang ba thams cad/ de dang de'i rang bzhin rmi lam sgyu ma lta bur rang sems skad cig ma'i steng du gtan la phab nas rtogs pa'i ched yin pa la dgongs pas so// gnyis pa bye brag tu bstan pa la/ dmigs med 'jigs dang bral ba'i skyabs su 'gro// zhes pa'i don ni/ don dam par mthar thug gi skyabs yul ni chos kyi dbyings rang bzhin rnam dag dang*/ spang bya glo bur gyi dri ma dang bral ba'i ye shes dbyer med pa ni sangs rgyas kyi chos kyi sku yin la/ dam pa'i chos mtshan nyid pa'ang de nyid yin zhing*/ dge 'dun gyi mthar thug kyang chos kyi sku yin pa'i phyir/ skyabs nyag gcig ni sangs rgyas nyid yin te/ rgyud bla ma las/ dam pa'i don du 'gro ba yi// skyabs ni sangs rgyas nyag gcig yin// skyob pa chos kyi sku can dang*// tshogs kyang de yi mthar thug phyir// zhes 'byung zhing*/ gnas skabs kyi skyabs gnas sku gsum sogs kyi rnam gzhag byed pa ltar na/ don dam chos sku ste/

rang don mthar phyin chos kyi sku dang*/ 'dus ma byas dang*/ lhun gyis grub pa dang*/ gzhan gyi rkyen gyis rtogs pa min pa sogs rtogs pas mkhyen pa dang*/ 'jigs pa med pa'i lam gzhan la ston pa'i brtse ba'i thugs rje dang*/ de dag gis 'gro ba'i nyon mongs dang sdug bsngal spong ba'i nus pa dang ldan pa'i kun rdzob kyi sku gnyis ni gzhan don mthar phyin sangs rgyas te/ mgon po byams pas/ 'dus ma byas shing lhun gyis grub// gzhan gyi rkyen gyis rtogs min pa// mkhyen dang brtse ba nus par ldan// don gnyis ldan pa'i sangs rgyas nyid// ces so// des na 'dir skabs su bab pa lam gyi skyabs 'gro ni gong du bshad pa ltar 'khor 'das dbyer med kyi tshul du nyams su len pa yin te/ gang la skyabs su 'gro ba'i yul dkon mchog gang gis skyabs su 'gro ba'i gang zag ji ltar skyabs su 'gro ba'i tshul rnams/ kun rdzob tu so sor snang tsam ma 'gags pa skyabs 'gro'i rnam gzhag ltar yin la/ bskyab bya 'khor ba dang ngan song gi 'jigs pa'am/ yid mtshan rtog gi 'jigs pa rnams/ don dam par shes rab kyi dbang pos dpyad ngor/ chos dang gang zag gi bdag gnyis dang*/ phung po rnam rig sogs kyis stong pa/ skye 'jig 'gro 'ong sogs cir yang ma grub pa'i phyir dang*/ skyabs yul gyi rang bzhin yang*/ mdo las/ sangs rgyas ni rmi lam lta bu/ sgyu ma lta bu/ mya ngan las 'das pa'ang rmi lam lta bu/ sgyu ma lta bu/ mya ngan las 'das pa las khyad par du 'phags pa'i chos gzhan zhig yod na de'ang sgyu ma lta bu/ rmi lam lta bu'o// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir chos thams cad phan tshun ltos grub rten cing 'brel 'byung gi rang bzhin mtha' bral gyi stong pa nyid du rtogs dgos kyi/ ri bong gi rwa lta bu'i stong nyid du ni mi gzung ngo*// dri ba gnyis pa/ tshad bral dmigs yul spangs pa'i sems bskyed bya// zhes pa'i don ni/

spyir sems bskyed la/ gzhan don gyi phyir sangs rgyas thob pa 'dod pa dang*/ de'i phyir lam la slob pa gnyis te/ de skad du'ang*/ 'gro bar 'dod dang 'gro ba yis// bye brag ji ltar shes pa ltar// de bzhin mkhas pas de gnyis kyi// bye brag rim bzhin shes par bya// zhes kun rdzob tu smon 'jug gnyis dang*/ don dam sems bskyed ni chos la mi rtog pa'i ye shes skyes pa ste/ de bskyed pa'i thabs ni tshogs gnyis bsags pa ste/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rab bsnyen bya// bsod nams ye shes tshogs rab bsags/ chos la mi rtog ye shes ni// skye phyir de ni dam par 'dod// ces 'byung ba ltar ro// 'dir skabs su bab pa'ang bden gnyis zung 'jug tu nyams su len pa'i don te/ tshad dang grangs med pa'i sems can bdag tu 'dzin pa dam pos bcings pas sdug bsngal sna tshogs kyis nyam nyes pa rnams kyi don bya ba la/ don bya ba'i yul/ sems can ngo bo nyid kyis grub pa med pa'i phyir na/ dmigs pa'i yul du gzung byar grub pa ci zhig yod de/ sdud pa las/ bdag ci 'dra bar de 'drar sems can thams cad shes// sems can thams cad ci 'dra de 'drar chos kun shes// zhes dang*/ spyod 'jug las/ 'gro ba rmi lam lta bu ste// rnam par dpyad na chu shing 'dra// zhes dang*/ gal te sems can yod min na// su la snying rje bya zhe na// 'bras bu'i don du khas blangs pa'i// rmongs pas btags pa gang yin pa'o// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ 'gro ba ngo bos ma grub pa la/ de ltar ma shes par/ bdag tu 'dzin pa dam pos bcings pa rnams kyi don bya ba'am/ bya byed las gsum mtshan mar 'dzin pa'i dmigs pa med par shes pa'i sgyu ma lta bu'i ngang nas spyad dgos so// zhes pa'i don du snang ngo*// dri ba gsum pa ni/ de dag tu ma zad/ dri tshig gis dngos su ma zin yang*/ sbyor dngos rjes gsum tshang ba zhes pa'i shugs las 'byung ba ltar na/

lam gyi dngos gzhi'i gnas skabs kyi lha sngags ye shes kyi rnal 'byor thams cad kyang zab gsal gnyis su med pa'i lha/ grag stong gnyis su med pa'i sngags/ rig stong gnyis su med pa'i ye shes thams cad la rnam par mi rtog pa'am/ mi dmigs pa'i lta bas zin pa nyid shin tu gtso che/ khyad par rnal 'byor bla med kyi nyams len skabs su/ rgyu dang lam dang 'bras bu'i gnas skabs kyi lhan cig skyes pa'i chos gsum po thams cad sems nyid rang rig rang gsal tsam du myong yang rang bzhin gang du ma grub pa kho na'i cho 'phrul du shes dgos te/ sems kyi mtshan nyid gsal ba 'khor ba/ rang bzhin stong pa myang 'das/ ngo bo zung 'jug dbyer med/ nyams su blang ba'i gnad gsum gyi skabs su/ chos can gsal ba 'khor ba/ chos nyid stong pa myang 'das/ ngo bo zung 'jug dbyer med/ de bzhin du rgyud gsum gyi skabs su/ gsal ba/ stong pa/ sems kyi ngo bo dang*/ thabs rgyud kyi skabs su/ sbyang gzhi/ sbyong byed/ sbyangs 'bras dang*/ 'bras bu'i rgyud kyi skabs su'ang*/ lhun grub/ gnas gyur/ mi 'gal ba thams cad kyang 'khor 'das dbyer med dam/ bden gnyis zung 'jug tu nyams su len pa nyid ni/ sangs rgyas sgrub pa'i lam gyi gtso bor go dgos te/ slob dpon ār+ya de bas/ 'khor ba mya ngan 'das pa zhes// de nyid ma mthong ba yi sems// 'khor med mya ngan 'das med ces// de nyid mthong ba rnams kyi sems// zhes dang*/ spyod 'jug las/ yan lag 'di dag thams cad ni// thub pas shes rab don du gsungs// de yi phyir na sdug bsngal dag /zhi bar 'dod pas shes rab bskyed// ces dang*/ kye rdo rje las/ rmongs phyir 'khor ba'i gzugs can nyid// rmongs med 'khor ba dag pas na// 'khor ba mya ngan 'das par 'gyur// byang chub sems ni mya ngan 'das// kun rdzob don dam tshul can no// zhes sogs rgya cher gsungs pa'i phyir nyams len thams cad bdag tu lta ba'i gnyen por 'gro nges pa'i dmigs pa med pa'i shes rab bskyed pa las gal che ba 'ga' yang bsgrub tu ma mchis te/

tshul 'di la goms pa'i rnal 'byor pas mtshan bcas kyi dge sbyor gang byas thams cad mi rtog pa'i ye shes 'ba' zhig tu 'bad rtsol la ma ltos par rang gi ngang gis 'gro bar 'byung ba yang*/ sdud pa las/ skye bo'i dbus na sgyu ma'i skyes bu 'di snyam du// skye bo 'di mgu bya snyam mi sems de yang byed// rdzu 'phrul sna tshogs rab tu ston par byed mthong yang*// de ni lus med sems med ming yang yod ma yin// de bzhin shes nas spyod pa nam yang 'di snyam du// byang chub rtogs nas 'gro ba yongs su dgrol mi sems// skye ba sna tshogs dang ni bya ba mang ldan pa// sgyu ma lta bur spyod kyang rnam par mi rtog spyod// ces dang*/ rje sa skya pa chen pos/ 'khrul pa chos kyi dbyings nyid du// shes pas rtogs pa thams cad kyang*// ji ltar bsgoms kyang mi rtog nyid// btsal yang 'khrul pa ga la rnyed// ces dang*/ rje btsun rin po ches kyang*/ 'di ltar shes pa'i rnal 'byor pa// bsgrub rgyu med kyang sgrub la brtson// bsgom rgyu med kyang sgom la brtson// bsrung rgyu med kyang dam tshig srung*// de ltar shes nas bde ste mchis// bsgrub tu med pa'i sangs rgyas de// rang gi sems la yod pa yin// bsgrub med sangs rgyas grub ste mchis// zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ dri ba bzhi pa/ bsags pa med pa'i dge rtsa byang chub bsngo// zhes pa'i don ni/ rang gzhan gyi rgyud du dug gsum gyis kun nas bslang ba med pa'i sgo gsum gyi dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad kyang*/ rgyu rkyen gyis mngon par 'dus byas pa yin pa'i phyir ma skyes pa rkyen la rag las gang de stong pa nyid// ces gsungs so// des na de ltar shes pa'i sgo nas bsngo ba'i yul bla na med pa'i byang chub ste zhing dang*/ ji ltar bsngo ba'i tshul gyi 'dun sems smon gsum ste bsam pa dang*/ 'khor 'das kyi 'gro bas 'du byas pa'i bsngo rgyu'i dge ba'i rtsa ba ste/

'khor gsum po 'di dang 'di'o zhes mtshan ma dang rnam par rtog pa can du dmigs na dug can gyi bsngo ba zhes sam/ shes bya'i sgrib pa'ang 'dod de/ de ni rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i rgyur mi 'gyur/ sdud pa las kyang*/ yongs bsngo gal te sems su 'du shes 'byung 'gyur zhing*// byang chub 'du shes yongs bsngo sems can 'du shes na// 'du shes phyir na lta gnas sems ni gsum la chags// dmigs pa yod pas yongs su bsngos par chud ma yin// zhes dang*/ ji ltar dug dang 'dres pa'i kha zas bzang za ba// dkar po'i chos la dmigs pa'ang de 'drar rgyal bas gsungs// zhes dang*/ mgon po byams pas kyang*/ 'khor gsum rnam par rtog pa gang*// de ni shes bya'i sgrib par 'dod// ces gsungs pa'i phyir/ des na 'khor gsum po snang tsam rang bzhin gyis dmigs pa med pa'i shes rab zab mo'i lta bas zin pa'i sgo nas bsngo ba bya dgos te/ mdo ting nge 'dzin rgyal po las/ sgyu ma byed pa dag gis gzugs sprul te// rta dang glang po shing rta sna tshogs byas// de la ji bzhin snang ba gang yang med// chos rnams thams cad de 'drar shes par gyis// zhes dang*/ sdud pa las kyang*/ gal te mtshan mar byed gang de ni bsngo ma yin// ci ste mtshan ma med na yongs su bsngo ba yin// zhes sogs rgya cher gsungs pas 'khor gsum dmigs pa med pa'i shes rab kyis zin pa'i bsngo ba bya dgos te/ rgyan las/ de ni dmigs med rnam pa can// phyin ci ma log mtshan nyid do// zhes gsungs pa'i don la dgongs pa'i phyir ro// mdor na ji skad bshad pa de dag thams cad shes rab stong pa nyid dang*/ thabs byin sogs bsod nams kyi tshogs sam/ yid mtshan rtogs las skyob pa'i spyod pa zung 'jug tu spyad pa'i rten 'brel la nan tan cher bskyed na srid pa'i rgya mtsho chen po las rang gzhan sgrol ba'i ded dpon mchog tu 'gyur ba ni rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i gsung rab kyis bstan bya'i snying po nyid do// 'dir smras pa/

ring nas smon lam mi dman grur zhugs nas// rnam 'dren bstan pa'i rin chen gling mchog son// theg gsum bslab pa'i thos bsam bsgoms byung gi /yon tan nor bus 'byor des dris pa'i lan// dpal stug dbang po gdung 'tshob bcas pa yis// legs gsungs sbrang rtsi'i rgyal mtshan grol ba las// phyogs re'i bcud myos blo gros rkang drug bus// mi 'gyur phreng ba bstar ba'i dbyangs chung phul// 'di sbyar dge ba kun phan ltar dkar bas// lus can rmongs pa thun gsum mun bzhin bcil// bden gnyis zung 'jug rtogs pa'i ku mu dās// dga' tshal mdzes bzhin phyogs kun brgyan par shog /ces skye dgu don grub gling gi kun spangs sangs rgyas kun bzang pa nas nyams len skabs kyi dogs gnas dri ba 'ga' zhig byung ba'i lan ldon kun phan gzhon nu zhes bya ba 'di ni/ rgyal ba gnyis pa rje btsun e waṃ pa chen po brgyud par bcas pa'i legs bshad bdud rtsi'i bcud kyis 'tsho ba'i ban+de 'byung du rung ba'i yon tan la ltos nas btags ming du/ ngag gi dbang po 'jigs bral phyogs las rnam par rgyal ba'i lha/ dbyangs can snyems pa'i lang tsho'i sde'am tshul khrims rin chen du bod pas/ sde dge lhun grub steng gi rgyal khab kyi dbang phyogs ba gam gsum par bris pa sarba maṅga laṃ bha wa tu// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
